svg.title: Wildbound — creature collection
svg.desc: 1440 × 900 collection menu. 900 × 680 modal with seven icon tabs, search and rarity filters, discovered and undiscovered portraits. Sample state: three garden friends found. The scroll viewport deliberately clips the second row. Editable vector design reference for the native Roblox implementation. This is not a Studio screenshot or a file created with Figma.
